name: Rio do Sul (Brazil)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, dark blue and yellow in the proportions 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms.
history: Rio do Sul is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil. The flag was adopted on 20 November 2001 (the present flag was adopted by Municipal Law No. 3,691 of 20 November 2001, amending the flag law of 1960, and the arms date from Law No. 367 of 15 October 1960, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: municipal arms with a mural crown, a shield with a landscape, an angel and a wheel, reading RIO DO SUL
